status: implemented, targeted checks passed; 500 ms target not reached

method.native: Real isolated Electron renderer saveRecord through the actual main IPC, durable outbox and storage worker; timer includes validation, receipt, canonical install and renderDetail. A separate reader verifies physical saved values after each operation. First cold round kept separate from four warm rounds.
method.fixture: 100 vehicles, 2500 parts, 1200 initial legacy audit events; only records count changes.
method.paint: Two requestAnimationFrame callbacks in hidden native windows have an artificial ~1 Hz compositor delay; paintMs is retained in raw artifacts and excluded from save latency.
method.server: Authenticated HTTP loopback, current write handshake, real persistent storage worker, production backup descriptor. Timer includes the complete HTTP response and JSON parse; excludes desktop UI and real LAN/WAN latency.
method.environment: Windows x64, Node 24.22.1, pinned source Electron 44.9.0. No cold OS cache eviction.

changes: VehicleRecordAction sends only editable row facts with all dependency revisions; backend still runs shared guards and writes a durable receipt.

SQLite changes only differing physical rows; a private frozen snapshot can be reused only inside its unchanged live connection and schema/total_changes boundary. Commit checks still re-read physical rows after hooks.
Pure background planning worker is reused; generic saves carry only dirty sections after complete input validation.
Canonical clones avoid a redundant stringify/parse; Node SHA-256 uses native crypto with the exact released UTF-8 hash format.
Unchanged private canonical rows and per-call structural/domain results are reused; source/context mutation invalidates exported transition sessions.
Import origin guards compare protected facts directly only after strict portable-JSON validation; legacy inputs retain the earlier path.
Current ownership/field ACL and proof checks remain; public projected rows remain independent mutable copies.
Active history keeps a bounded foreground window; every event, proof and receipt remains reachable in the immutable archive and backups. Physical/decode limits were not lowered.
Canonical file paths avoid duplicate ancestor traversals; fresh inode, route, no-link, object-content and fsync checks remain.
The journal patches only changed DOM rows and preserves selection/scroll. Confirmed unchanged drafts do not write. Unknown operations preserve their form and operation ID.

checks.status: targeted checks passed; no full suite
groups: Exact typed IDs, unknown field preservation, numeric precision, odometer mismatch, negative changed mileage, linked movements, closed periods, posted acts, CAS conflict and replay in SQLite/JSON.
SQLite diff/derived-field repair, private snapshot stale guards, hook-time physical mutation, root/ancestor inode replacement and symlink guards, immutable history/provider byte authentication.
History pagination/order, archived receipt lookup/current ACL, retention with batch201, lost-ACK canonical view, actual portable backup and restore.
Native/browser published v3.5.8 byte/hash fixtures, canonical clone error/order/ownership semantics, native SHA use and portable browser fallback.
Cost/import/inventory/repair/workflow reference-reuse parity, reverse links, calendar-sensitive ranges, malformed legacy fallback and source/context stale checks.

Browser command form: pending/unknown/error preservation, durable ACK path, no duplicate writes, fallback for old connections/dirty neighbors and no-op draft. Journal DOM refresh and ownership/field projection regressions.
Strict TypeScript core and application bundle checks; application architecture check; git diff --check.

limits: 500 ms was not achieved on either reported volume. These measurements are not an SLA for arbitrary data, hardware or network.
First save after startup, first history compaction and scheduled backups can be slower; cold results are explicitly included.

The one-record UI path requires the updated capability, a clean confirmed source and an unrestricted current connection. Old servers, scoped views and unrelated unsaved edits retain the complete guarded save path.
Full physical graph checks, unchanged-section dependencies and canonical whole-section ACK remain material costs. No early success or skipped guard was introduced to hit a timer.
